hero.heading: A white-label finance back office for firms serving the GCC.
hero.text: For business-setup firms, corporate service providers, and tax and advisory firms that want reliable, scalable delivery without hiring a full in-house team.

deliver: Bookkeeping, VAT, corporate tax preparation and payroll under your brand.
Monthly MIS and dashboards in your format or ours.
Audit readiness support for your clients’ licensed auditors.
Onboarding of new clients into your workspace and templates.
Documented standards, checklists and review steps on every client.
protect: Your licensed team signs off every filing that requires it.
You own the client relationship. We contact clients only if you ask us to.
Confidentiality terms on every engagement and role-based access.
Fixed monthly fee per client, set by tier, so margins are predictable.
Service levels written into the agreement.
stepsHeading: Four steps from pilot to scale

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: Start with 3 clients on a fixed monthly fee per client.

steps.title: Standardise
steps.text: Agree templates, checklists, service levels and review steps.

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: Add clients without adding headcount on your side.

steps.title: Review quarterly
steps.text: Review quality, turnaround and margin together.

faqs.q: Do you deal with my clients directly?
faqs.a: Only if you ask us to. You keep the client and the relationship. We run the back office under your brand and your service levels.

faqs.q: Who submits filings with the authorities?
faqs.a: Returns are submitted through your own portal accounts, or through a licensed tax agent where representation is required. Your licensed team reviews and signs off filings that require it. We prepare everything and walk you through approval.

faqs.q: Can we use our own software and templates?
faqs.a: Yes. We work inside your software and templates, or ours, as you prefer.
